name: gina-lib-nunjucks-resolver
description: Detects a project-installed nunjucks package and caches it on process.gina._nunjucks. Unlike swig-resolver, there is no framework-bundled fallback: nunjucks is opt-in via render.engine="nunjucks", and load() throws NUNJUCKS_NOT_INSTALLED when the package is absent — the bundle fails at startup instead of mid-render.
